run_f_gold: run f_gold to replace duplicates and out-of-range values with missing numbers 1 to n in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against filled function f_filled using parameter sets to verify permutation correctness
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary for counting element frequencies
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that finds next missing positive integer and replaces invalid array elements in-place
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which transforms an array into a permutation of numbers 1 through n by filling gaps
